entry.title: GitLab Patch Release: 19.5.5, 19.4.7
entry.content:
On November 12, 2026, we released versions 19.5.5, 19.4.7 for GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition.

These versions resolve a number of regressions and bugs. This patch release does not include any security fixes.

GitLab Orbit is now available in GitLab 19.4 and 19.5

entry.title: GitLab Critical Patch Release: 19.5.4, 19.4.6, 19.3.8
entry.content:
On November 10, 2026, we released versions 19.5.4, 19.4.6, 19.3.8 for GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition.

These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to one of these versions immediately. GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated are already running a patched version. GitLab.com and GitLab Dedicated customers do not need to take action.

entry.title: GitLab Patch Release and Security Update: 19.5.3, 19.4.5, 19.3.7, 19.2.10, 19.1.10, 19.0.11, 18.11.14
entry.content:

GitLab.com is already running the patched version. GitLab Dedicated tenants running 19.4.3-internal0 or later already include these fixes and do not need to take action.

entry.title: GitLab 19.5 release notes
entry.content:
On October 15, 2026, GitLab 19.5 was released with the following features.

We are excited to recognize Dhairya, a Level 3 contributor, as this month’s Notable Contributor!

Dhairya contributed to offline transfer and Organizations support for import, so that groups, projects, and their memberships can move between GitLab instances.

Before you upgrade to GitLab 19.5, review the upgrade notes and the deprecations and removals for GitLab 19.5.
